intro: Commander Springvale was once a devoted paladin and a commander at Shadowfang Keep. Slain alongside his men during the feral worgen slaughter orchestrated by Archmage Arugal, his vengeful spirit remains behind to haunt the castle halls. Even in death, his ghost fiercely guards the keep against all who enter.

p: Before the ruin of Shadowfang Keep, Commander Springvale stood as an honorable paladin dedicated to the Holy Light. Leading the garrison in Silverpine Forest, he oversaw the keep's security during the fraught days following the fall of Lordaeron to the Scourge.

When Archmage Arugal summoned the extraplanar worgen to bolster Dalaran's failing ranks against the undead Scourge, the wild beasts quickly slipped from the mage's control. The ravenous pack descended upon the fortress, slaughtering Baron Silverlaine and his entire guard. Springvale perished in the halls he had sworn to protect, his service violently cut short.

Death offered no release to Springvale. His ghost haunts the keep's council room alongside its spectral soldiers. He still wields paladin powers, including Holy Light and Hammer of Justice, against intruders.
